$Comment: Snowman henchman summoned by the Ice King with the Gunters (2026-10-21, concept 'SNOW MEN': slow, his hug freezes at once, melts after a while). Variant of vanilla Template_Predator like AT_Gunter_Minion. Slow (MaxSpeed 3), weak (40 HP); the hug (Root_AT_Snowman_Hug, Fox_Bite window) does 3 damage and freezes 2 s (AT_Snowman_Hug_Freeze, freeze guard respected). AT_Snowman_Melting in CombatConfig EntityEffects melts him in about 20 s (2 fire damage a second). Model AT_Snowman (placeholder). 2026-10-21 (playtest: they walk too fast): MaxSpeed 2 (was 3), ChaseRelativeSpeed and CombatMovingRelativeSpeed 0.8 (were 1). 2026-10-21: 2.5 blocks tall now (art): AttackDistance 2.6 (was 1.8) and CombatBehaviorDistance 5 (4) to match the longer hug reach (AT_Snowman_Hug EndDistance 3). 2026-10-22 (playtest: defend the king like a pack): FlockArray set, which turns on Template_Predator's 'Flock_Attack' listener while Idle/asleep: the king's beacon (payload = whoever hit him) makes them lock that attacker and fight (LockedTarget, Combat.Maybe). Side effect, also wanted: henchmen flock together, and when one engages the rest join (vanilla pack behaviour). Already fighting someone, they keep their target. 2026-10-22, reverted the same day: with FlockArray set they stopped attacking the player while he hit the king. Template_Predator's flock logic made the members follow and target their flock leader, and the king's Flock_Attack beacon sent them to the random Combat.Maybe check (ChanceToBeAlertedWhenFlockAlerted 70) on every hit, back to Idle, where the target is cleared. FlockArray removed; they detect players on their own as before. The king's beacon stays harmless (nobody listens to it now). 2026-10-22 (playtest: sometimes the king hits the Gunters first and they hit him back, that must never happen): DisableDamageGroups [Self, AT_Ice_King_Group]. The victim's list makes vanilla cancel damage from those groups (NPCDamageSystems.FilterDamageSystem -> CombatSupport.getCanCauseDamage) unless the attacker's running Attack has DamageFriendlies (the king's do, so his ultimate still hurts them), and the Damage sensor that locks the attacker (Template_Predator, Friendly false) skips attackers in those groups (SensorDamage), so a henchman never targets the king for a hit. Their own attacks also hold fire with the king in the line (ActionAttack AvoidFriendlyFire).
